personality_one_liner: A chunky, energetic, and touchable arcade hub that ties together distinct mini-games under one delightfully tactile roof.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around chunky components; use spacing to group logical elements without borders where possible.

do's: Use over the hero game carousel
Use on bottom tabs to keep the games visible underneath
dont's: Don't use on game cards in the grid
Don't use on buttons - keep buttons solid and chunky

screens.name: HubHome
screens.purpose: A central grid and carousel to discover and launch the 3 mini-games instantly.

states.empty: Lottie/Illustration of an unplugged arcade machine.
states.error: Error message with a big chunky 'Retry' pill button.

screens.layout: Use a featured horizontal carousel at the top for the 'Game of the Day' with a glass title bar. Below it, a 2-column grid or large vertical list of 'All Games'. Each game card adapts its background tint to its specific theme color.

screens.name: GameStart
screens.purpose: The lobby for an individual game showing best score, ranking, and a massive PLAY button.

states.empty: No previous scores -> 'Play your first game!'

screens.layout: Full-bleed background using the game's specific brand color (light blue, peach, or bamboo green) with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Large title, a centralized high-score module, and a sticky bottom CTA (PLAY) inside a glass container.

screens.name: InGameHUD
screens.purpose: Heads-up display overlaid on the game canvas.
screens.layout: Minimalist absolute-positioned floating pills at the top edge (Score, Lives) and a pause icon button. Avoid heavy backgrounds to maximize gameplay visibility.

screens.name: GameOverOverlay
screens.purpose: Immediate feedback upon dying/failing, showing score and quick retry.
screens.layout: A dimmed glassmorphism backdrop over the frozen game state. A chunky modal in the center displaying 'Game Over', final score, 'New High Score' badge, and two massive side-by-side buttons: Home and Retry.

screens.name: Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Global ranking tab for all games.
screens.layout: Top tab bar to toggle between the 3 games. A vertical list of players (Rank, Avatar, Score). The top 3 rows are emphasized with larger height and gold/silver/bronze tints.

game_nailing.alt: Hammer hitting a nail into wood

game_plum.alt: A single peach on a warm background

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt the 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality. Buttons should be chunky, deeply rounded (pill or lg radius), and highly pressable to feel like arcade buttons.

The user explicitly requested color themes for the 3 mini-games. Blue is specifically ALLOWED here because the prompt asks for 'Nailing Master = light blue sky/clean'. Use the custom color tokens (nailingMasterBrand, plumPeachBrand, ninjaJumperBrand) for game-specific accents, backgrounds, and Start Screen theming.
When rendering Game cards on the HubHome screen, tint the card background to the respective game's brand color, maintaining strong contrast with the text/icons.
For the Start Screen of any game, ensure the hero image is covered by a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) so text stays legible.
In-game HUDs must use absolute positioning with high contrast pills, avoiding heavy solid bars that block gameplay.
The Game Over overlay should be a centralized, playful Modal centered on a glassmorphic background that lets the frozen game peek through. Use oversized 'Retry' buttons.
Implement haptic feedback heavily. 'Bumps' when navigating, 'success' pops on Play button, and quick tactile ticks when opening the Game Over overlay.
Ensure safe area is respected at all screen roots, except where the In-game HUD relies on the topmost edge, in which case use Safe Area padding explicitly for the absolute positioned pills.
